title: custodial_create
description: Formal spec §7.1. The genesis operation for a did:guardian identity.

did.description: REQ-7.1-3/REQ-7.1-10: the full DID this genesis creates. MUST equal did:guardian:<domain>[:<name>] under the accepting registrar's own domain (Fix 2) -- a registrar MUST reject a mismatched did, closing cross-registrar genesis replay.

operationalKeys.description: REQ-7.1-3: must be present. Each entry is a Multikey string.

outgoing.description: Always empty at genesis -- nothing to remove.

incoming.description: REQ-7.1-1 (v0.3, relaxed): MAY name one or more guardians directly at genesis -- each named DID MUST co-sign, as one of the proofs in `proof`.

creator.description: REQ-7.1-4: the DID of whichever party initiated this registration. Carries no signature requirement.

policy.description: REQ-7.1-7: optional full or partial GuardianPolicy proposed at genesis.

proof.description: REQ-6-7: one proof per operational key's own proof of possession (REQ-7.1-8), one per co-signing incoming guardian (REQ-7.1-1), and the accepting registrar's own attestation (REQ-7.1-5) -- except when `did` names the registrar itself, where its own proof of possession stands in for the attestation (Fix 7).
